Subject: Depression over north Andaman Sea and adjoining Myanmar coast 
The Well Marked Low Pressure Area over north Andaman Sea & adjoining Myanmar coast 
moved north-northwestwards, intensified into a Depression and lay centred at 0530 hrs 
IST of today , the 28 th September 2026 over the same region  near latitude 15. 6°N and 
longitude 97.6°E, about 100km south  of Mawlamyine (Myanmar) , 200km southeast  of 
Yangon (Myanmar), and 480km east -northeast of Coco Island (Myanmar) and 590km 
east-northeast of Mayabandar (Andaman Islands, India).  
It is very likely to intensify into a Deep Depression during next 12  hours and continue to 
move north-northwestwards along & off Myanmar–Bangladesh coasts towards northeast 
Bay of Bengal & adjoining Bangladesh coasts during next 2 days. 
 
Warnings: 
(i) Rainfall Warning: 
Light to moderate rainfall at most places with isolated heavy rainfall very likely over 
Andaman & Nicobar Islands on 28th September. 
(ii) Wind warning: 
Thundersquall (wind speed reaching 50-60 kmph gusting to 70 kmph) likely over Andaman 
Islands on 28th September. 
Squally weather with wind speed reaching 40 -50 kmph gusting to 60 kmph is likely to 
prevail over Andaman Sea & adjoining areas of Eastcentral & southeast Bay of Bengal 
and along & off Myanmar coast till evening of today, the 28th September. 
Squally weather with wind speed reaching 50-60 kmph gusting to 70 kmph is likely to 
prevail over along & off Myanmar and adjoining areas of eastcentral Bay of Bengal from 
28th evening to 30th September evening and becoming 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph 
India Meteorological Department 
 (Ministry of Earth Sciences) 
 

along & off Bangladesh coast & adjoining areas of northeast Bay of Bengal during 29 th 
September to 1st October, 2026.  
(iii) Sea condition 
Sea condition is very likely to be rough to very rough Andaman Sea &  adjoining areas of 
eastcentral & southeast Bay of Bengal and along & off Myanmar coast till 28th September 
evening and over Myanmar and adjoining areas of Eastcentral from 28th evening to 30th 
September evening, and along & off Bangladesh coast & adjoining areas of northeast Bay 
of Bengal during 29th September to 1st October, 2026. 
(iv) Fishermen warnings 
Fishermen are advised not to venture into Andaman Sea & adjoining areas of southeast 
Bay of Bengal and along & off Myanmar coast till 28th September evening and along & off 
Myanmar coast and adjoining areas of eastcentral Bay of Bengal from 28 th evening to 
30th September evening and along & off Bangladesh coast & adjoining areas of northeast 
Bay of Bengal during 29th September to 1st October, 2026.  
 
(v) Impact expected (Andaman Islands for squally wind & heavy rainfall): 
 
❖ Breaking of tree branches, uprooting of small trees like banana, papaya, drum sticks. 
❖ Strong wind and rain may damage plantation, horticulture and standing crops. 
❖ Partial damage to vulnerable structures due to strong winds and rain. 
❖ Loose objects may fly. 
❖ Onshore and offshore operations may get affected. 
❖ Small ships, trawlers and boats may be affected. 
❖ Occasional reduction in visibility due to heavy rainfall. 
❖ Helicopter services may get affected. 
 
Action suggested: 
❖ People are advised to keep a watch on the weather for worsening conditions and be ready to 
move to safer places accordingly.  
❖ Surface transport may be regulated. 
❖ Fishing operation may be suspended.  
❖ Tourism and recreational activities to be regulated. 
❖ Onshore and offshore activities to be judiciously regulated. 
❖ Helicopter services to be regulated. 
 
Next bulletin will be issued at 1230 hours IST of today, the 28th September, 2026. 
 
 
(Umasankar Das) 
IMD, New Delhi
